Below is a **complete list of long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
It includes the federal holidays that create long weekends for the whole country, plus the provincial holidays that also give you a three‑day break.  

I’ve provided both a quick‑reference table and a machine‑readable JSON array so you can copy‑paste straight into your holiday‑planning app.

---

## 1️⃣ Quick‑Reference Table

| Date Range (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) Covered |
|-------------------|---------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | All provinces & territories |
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day | Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories |
| **Jun 30 – Jul 2** | Canada Day (observed Jun 30) | All provinces & territories |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories |
| **Nov 10 – 12** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 10) | All provinces & territories |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas | All provinces & territories |

### Provincial‑Only Long Weekends

| Date Range (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) |
|-------------------|---------|-------------|
| **Mar 17 – 19** | St. Patrick’s Day | Newfoundland & Labrador |
| **Jun 17 – 19** | New Brunswick Day | New Brunswick |
| **Jun 19 – 21** | Manitoba Day | Manitoba |
| **Jun 19 – 21** | Saskatchewan Day | Saskatchewan |

| **Aug 5 – 7** | Alberta Day | Alberta |
| **Aug 5 – 7** | Saskatchewan Day | Saskatchewan |
| **Aug 5 – 7** | Manitoba Day | Manitoba |

> **Note:**  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day is the nearest weekday (e.g., Canada Day 2023 fell on Saturday Jul 1, so it was observed on Friday Jun 30).  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that are not listed here (e.g., Ontario’s *Family Day* is already included, but Quebec’s *St. Jean Baptiste Day* is shown above).  
> • The table above covers all **long weekends** (Friday‑to‑Sunday or Sunday‑to‑Tuesday) that arise from public holidays in 2023.
